WITH team_totals AS (
    SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games
    FROM home_game
    GROUP BY team_id
),
all_totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_home_games) AS grand_total
    FROM team_totals
),
record_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(games) AS avg_record_games
    FROM home_game
)
SELECT
    t.team_id,
    t.total_home_games,
    t.total_home_games * 1.0 / a.grand_total AS fraction_of_all,
    t.total_home_games * 1.0 / r.avg_record_games AS ratio_to_record_average
FROM team_totals AS t
CROSS JOIN all_totals AS a
CROSS JOIN record_average AS r
ORDER BY ratio_to_record_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
